title: Courtesy-Linked Discount Table for the Rental Vehicle Coordination Self-Pay Day Rate
content:
**Discount table.** The network-delay discount on the self-pay charge of a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental follows the network courtesy days standing on the reservation: 3 courtesy days or more take 10 percent; at least one but fewer than 3 courtesy days take 5 percent; no courtesy days take zero. The self-pay day rate is the class partner daily rate reduced by the percent discounts that apply to it; where more than one applies, the percents are added together first and taken off the partner daily rate once.

## Records read

The days of every covered-day authorization on the reservation whose reason is network delay courtesy, paid by the network, added together.

## Discount by courtesy days standing

| Network courtesy days on the reservation | Network-delay discount |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 or 2 | 5 percent |
| 3 or more | 10 percent |

## Hypothetical cases

- Two network courtesy authorizations of 1 day and 2 days stand: 3 courtesy days, so 10 percent.
- One network courtesy authorization of 2 days: 5 percent.
- A Minivan Rental (partner daily rate 74.99 USD) with 5 percent from this table and no other percent discount on the day rate: a self-pay day rate of 71.2405 USD; with another 10 percent also applying, 15 percent is taken off once, 63.7415 USD.
